description: Classical MD of the AlphaFold 3 Rab10(1-175, GTP, Mg2+):KIF13A(1085-1160) complex. Four arms x three starts x 100 ns. Same simulation conventions as the KIF13A monomer main arm (ff19SB + OPC, 0.15 M NaCl, 310 K, 1 bar, 2 fs, HBonds, PME 1.0 nm, LangevinMiddle 1/ps, MC barostat).

tether.decision: Coordinator decision 2026-10-05: K1122R starts isosteric with WT (tethered to E1130); K1122E_paired stays as built.
tether.reason: The K1122R arm asks whether Arg keeps the K1122-E1130 tether, so it must start tethered like WT; an untethered start would measure re-formation instead.

position_pull.target: WT K1122 NZ of the same AF3 start

salt_bridge_pull.pair: closest R1122 NE/NH1/NH2 to E1130 OE1/OE2
salt_bridge_pull.applied: only if the position pull leaves the closest N-O above accept_A

tether.release: all pulls switched off and the system re-minimised with the standard relaxation restraints

parameters.ion_set_note: leaprc.water.opc loads frcmod.ionslm_126_opc: Na+ and Cl- 12-6 HFE set (Sengupta et al. 2021), Mg2+ 12-6 CM set (Li et al. 2020); same values as OpenMM amber19/opc.xml used by the monomer main arm.

his.rule: pKa < 6.0: neutral, tautomer by H-bond analysis (HID/HIE, tie -> HIE); pKa > 7.5: HIP; 6.0 <= pKa <= 7.5: majority species at pH 7.0 (neutral if pKa < 7.0, else HIP) and flagged as a candidate sensitivity arm.

mutant_relax.method: PDBFixer 1.12 side-chain replacement beyond CB (N, CA, C, O, CB kept), then ff19SB + GBn2 (mbondi3, 0.15 M) restrained minimisation of the dry tleap topology
mutant_relax.free_atoms: all hydrogens plus residue-1122 side-chain heavy atoms beyond CB (paired mutants only)

mg_restraints.form: E = 0.5 k (r - r_fb)^2 for r > r_fb, 0 otherwise; r_fb = AF3 distance + margin

solvation.rotation_safe_rule: nearest periodic image distance (TO box length a) >= solute diameter (all atoms) + 2 x 12 A; the solvateOct buffer is raised until this holds, so the gap to the nearest image stays >= 24 A in any orientation of the rigid complex
solvation.salt_rule: pairs = floor((N_water - N_neutralising) * 0.15 / 55.4 + 0.5), the OpenMM Modeller rule used by the monomer main arm

restraint_sets.backbone: protein N, CA, C, O, cap heavy atoms, GTP heavy atoms and Mg2+

simulation.restraint_units: kJ/mol/nm^2 (harmonic, periodic distance to the prepared coordinates)

analysis.charge_atoms_note: Barlow-Thornton style charged groups: ARG NE/NH1/NH2, LYS NZ, HIP ND1/NE2, Rab10 M1 N (+); ASP OD1/OD2, GLU OE1/OE2 (-). The monomer main arm used ARG NH1/NH2 only.
